title: Chapter 264 Return To The Academy
content:
Chapter 264 Return To The Academy

He hasn't fought for a long time, and he has no place to vent his blood.

And now, the deserted city has been escaping for 300,000 years.

Well, let’s practice honestly.

I just hope that the city lord will not let them down. In 300,000 years, they must fight happily.

As the seal around the deserted city gradually stabilized, the entire deserted city completely isolated all perceptions of the outside world.

In the galaxy.

Lu Daosheng breathed a sigh of relief, then swung hard in the direction behind him.

Suddenly, the deserted city instantly flew into the depths of the galaxy like a meteor.

boom!

With a loud bang, the entire galaxy suddenly trembled.

The deserted city steadily landed within the terrifying void turbulence outside the immortal world.

"Everything is all done."

Lu Daosheng stood in the vast galaxy, with his back against the endless nothingness, with a beautiful woman beside him, with a faint smile on his face.

At this moment, the fairy world must have begun to undergo a huge change.

Buzz rumble!

At this moment, a strange movement suddenly came from the abyss of nothingness behind Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked back at the same time.

A terrifying aura suddenly crushed towards this side.

The silent galaxy began to tremble wildly.

"Those who block my tribe will die!"

A majestic voice came from the other side of the abyss, and its aura was many times stronger than that of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

But Lu Daosheng and the others didn't have any fear in their eyes.

Instead, his expression was extremely dull.

The two looked at each other.

"I'll do it."

Yan Lingyun spoke softly and then went forward with her body.

With a bang.

Yan Lingyun stepped on the starry sky without saying anything nonsense, and directly punched forward.

boom!

Thousands of fist lights surged out, mixed with a terrifying aura, and the entire abyss was directly penetrated into a hideous gap.

"ah!!"

The next moment, the screams sounded from the other side of the abyss.

Immediately afterwards, in less than a moment, the breath completely subsided and there was no movement.

The entire galaxy has returned to peace.

.........

At the same time, the fairy world.

The moment the deserted city disappeared, the entire fairy world, including the fairyland, began to buzz.

Countless ancient strong men woke up from their sleep, feeling the movements coming from the world, and were immediately ecstatic.

"The golden age is coming, the golden age is coming!"

Wood Fairy World.

There were strange movements coming from several deserted places.

The dazzling rays of light soared into the sky, breaking through the sky, auspicious auras spread across the radius of thousands of miles, and the hazy purple aura kept floating in the void.

It is a blessing in the world!

Seeing this scene, everyone cheered, feeling the huge changes in the world, and was very excited.

Many older generation strong people have ushered in their second spring.

Several practitioners also had abnormal movements from their bodies, and their powerful constitutions were awakened directly, and strange phenomena covered the sky.

Many physiques that only exist in legends appear in various places in the fairy world.

This kind of scene not only happens in the Wood Immortal Realm.

A similar scene is happening in the entire fairy world, including the fairyland.

In the fairyland, many ancient forces no longer avoided the world, but began to show their strengths.

In the realm of Wood Immortal.

Four figures were constantly heading towards the direction of the fairyland.

"Sister Xue, the world has changed a lot."

Qin Feng felt the changes around him and said solemnly.

Thinking that Lu Xue’s father Lu Daosheng said that the fairy world would usher in a great enemy, Qin Feng also began to worry.

"Sister Xue, what should I do now?"

Xiao Luo didn't say anything, but looked at Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered for a moment and said, "Go back to the Immortal Realm first."

Now, her top priority is to use all resources to improve her strength.

Only when you have the strength can everything that follows be more convenient.

What's more, my parents are gone, and the deserted city is gone.

Now, it's really up to her.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue couldn't help but sigh in her heart.

Suddenly he became the savior of the world, and whoever he lets him go will not be confused.

Qin Feng and the others naturally did not refute Lu Xue's words.

Yuanyuan was even more behind the three of them, without saying a word.

Soon, the four of them accelerated and headed towards the direction of the fairyland.

Immortal Realm, in the Tiandi Academy.

After Jordanyang returned to the academy, he learned about Bai Lushuang’s actions. Jordanyang was not angry about this, but his expression was a little heavy.

"Go to Wuya Mountain and face the wall to think about your mistakes."

In the end, Bai Lushuang went to Wuya Mountain without a deadline.

Only when Jordanyang asks her to come back can Bai Lushuang come back.

After sitting on the alchemy peak for a long time, Jordanyang finally decided to go to Zhuyun Peak.

A moment later, a red-eyed old man appeared under Zhuyun Peak.

Jordanyang looked at Zhuyun Peak, with a hint of complexity in his eyes.

Now, since he went to the Wood Immortal Realm, his temper has been cured immediately.

Shaking his head slightly, Jordanyang flew directly into the peak.

"I've met Master Qiao."

As soon as he entered Zhuyun Peak, a sweeper saw Jordanyang, and then quickly put down the broom in his hand and saluted respectfully.

In response to this, Jordan Yang nodded faintly and said, "Where is your peak master, Mentor Xiao?"

Upon hearing this, Xiaosheng said, "Teacher Qiao, Teacher Xiao has something to do, and she has left Zhuyun Peak."

"Leave?"

Jordanyang frowned slightly.

"Do you know what she did?"

Xiaosheng said, "Teacher Qiao, Teacher Xiao is going to make the ranking."

Make a ranking.

This matter is now known to the entire fairyland.

After all, the Immortal Emperor List is so loud, unless it is a deaf person.

"Play the ranking?! But the list of the Immortal Emperor?"

When he heard the rankings, Jordan Yang asked in surprise.

When Jordan Yang asked so loudly, the young actor couldn't help but tremble all over, and he was confused at the same time.

Teacher Xiao’s peak strength in the Immortal Emperor Realm, if he doesn’t play the Immortal Emperor List, would he play the Immortal Emperor List?

But he naturally wouldn't say it, otherwise he wouldn't even have a position to sweep the floor in the academy.

"Yes, Mentor Qiao, it's the Immortal Emperor List."

At this moment, Jordanyang gradually recovered.

Although it was a bit surprising that Xiao Yin suddenly went to the Immortal Emperor List, it was reasonable.

"I'll ask you another thing, Lu Xue, will Miss Lu come back?"

"Return to Mentor Qiao, Miss Lu has not come back."

Jordan Yang frowned even more.

After a trip, I knew nothing about Xiao Yin going to play the Immortal Emperor List.

And at this moment, a figure in white suddenly descended into Zhuyun Peak.

"Teacher Tan, the president notified that the meeting hall gathered to discuss the matter."

Upon hearing this, Jordan Yang nodded solemnly, "I understand."

After he left, Jordanyang stood there, wondering what he was thinking.

"Forget it, everything will be returned to heaven."

Immediately, Jordanyang broke through the air and headed straight to the Heaven and Earth Academy's Council Hall.

Jordanyang dared not underestimate the gathering of the House of Deliberations.

You know, the Heaven and Earth Academy has had a meeting with the Seminar Hall for at least hundreds of years.
